parties.respondent: The State of Madhya Pradesh and Another

summary: High Court's intervention in bail proceedings justified under Articles 226/227; absence of FSL report in case diary; failure to conduct DNA examination; findings of dereliction of duty, insubordination; departmental proceedings initiated; scope of bail applications under Section 439 CrPC; distinguishable from Sangitaben and Murugesan; High Court's constitutional role in preventing miscarriage of justice; direction for action upheld in light of constitutional powers.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India Art.214, Art.226, Art.227
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 s.3, s.4
Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(W)(ii), s.3(2)(V)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of the High Court upheld with observations on constitutional powers under Articles 226 and 227.
